usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-interest` command. It charges each invoice still unpaid more than 60 days after its due date a one-time interest of 1% of the invoice amount, and the interest counts toward the invoice's outstanding amount and the customer's balance. `help` now lists it right after `run-late-fees`, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (10 tests, 0 failed); this is committed along with `.work/report.json`.
The report lists three open questions: whether nonprofits are exempt (they are charged now, because DEC-B14 states no exception), whether `show` should display interest (its outstanding figure already includes it), and how interest will work with sales tax.
OUTCOME: completed
